title: INSERT OR IGNORE + fallback pattern in ChatStore::create is correct and battle-tested
description: kith-store/src/chat.rs:42-86 — the create() function handles two distinct INSERT OR IGNORE cases: (1) same chat_id PK already exists (retry path: get(chat_id) returns it), (2) same contact_id UNIQUE constraint fires (concurrent create: fall back to find_direct_by_contact_id). State counter advance is correctly tied to affected > 0, so no spurious state advances on any IGNORE path. A future contributor might try to simplify this to a single lookup, which would break the retry-path idempotency. The two-case design should be preserved.
